# AutoFlow Tech

> Interactive calculators, financial modeling tools, and automated blueprint resources for solopreneurs, day-traders, and automation engineers. Cut SaaS infrastructure and trading friction costs by 80% to 95%.

AutoFlow Tech provides 7 client-side, zero-latency financial calculators, rule scanners, and automation code generators. All tools run 100% in-browser with zero paywalls, zero ads, and zero latency.

## Tools & Interactive Calculators

- [Make vs Zapier ROI Calculator](https://ceopatinhalo-ai.github.io/automation-calculator/index.html): Compare task pricing tiers between Make.com and Zapier. Calculate annual savings (up to 85% or $1,500 - $3,396/year) by migrating workflows to Make.com.
- [Forex Position Sizing & Spread Calculator](https://ceopatinhalo-ai.github.io/automation-calculator/forex-calculator.html): Institutional pip risk and lot sizing calculator for Forex & Gold (XAU/USD). Computes real cost of retail broker markups vs True ECN raw spreads on IC Markets and Exness.
- [Prop Firm Drawdown Simulator](https://ceopatinhalo-ai.github.io/automation-calculator/propfirm-calculator.html): Simulate maximum daily loss (5%) and overall trailing drawdown for FTMO, FundingPips, and FundedNext challenge accounts.
- [Cloud VPS AI Cost Calculator](https://ceopatinhalo-ai.github.io/automation-calculator/vps-calculator.html): Compare monthly cost of hosting 24/7 autonomous AI agents on Hostinger Cloud VPS ($4.99/mo) vs AWS EC2 ($45/mo).
- [1-Click AI Agent Cloud Generator](https://ceopatinhalo-ai.github.io/automation-calculator/ai-agent-cloud-generator.html): Instant 1-line bash command generator to automatically install Docker, n8n, DeepSeek, and Telegram alert bots on clean Ubuntu VPS.
- [Prop Firm Hidden Rule Scanner](https://ceopatinhalo-ai.github.io/automation-calculator/propfirm-rule-scanner.html): Real-time analysis of hidden weekend holding, news trading bans, slippage thresholds, and drawdown buffer rules across top 5 prop firms.
- [LLM API Cost & Arbitrage Calculator](https://ceopatinhalo-ai.github.io/automation-calculator/llm-api-calculator.html): Arbitrage token pricing between OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet), and DeepSeek (V3/R1). Slash API bills by up to 95% using OpenRouter and self-hosted models.
